shortDescription: Configure OSPFv2 interface mode protocol settings on SONiC.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the operation to be performed on the OSPFv2 interfaces configured on the device. In case of merged, the input configuration will be merged with the existing OSPFv2 interfaces configuration on the device. In case of deleted, the existing OSPFv2 interfaces configuration will be removed from the device.
